owner_instruction: Не настраивать500монет вручную по одной. Подключение и проверка массового покрытия на уровне источника; это касается карт ликвидаций и остальных блоков.

required_design.coverage: Provider full catalogue/pagination -> exact canonical join to selected550 -> perblock status matrix
required_design.bulk: Use genuine bulk endpoints where offered; cached shared response reused by candidates
required_design.single_symbol: Automatic parameterized reads only when API is single-symbol and candidate-stage needs them; not manual percoinsetup
required_design.qualification_sample: One affected sample qualifies parser/semantics only; not proof for all550
required_design.cache: Same provider/route/nativeID/requestshape and original source/event/expiry clocks; cachehit never refreshes factage
required_design.duplicate_connectors: Wrappers of same upstream share one quota/cache; no multiplied budgets

separate_claims: Useful block consumed by real analysis
coverage_evidence.all550_claim: Only complete exact join/coverage proof; no extrapolation from DOOD or SOL
coverage_evidence.future_map: Observed open positions or documented modeled future levels only; liquidation history and ordinary pricelevels do not replace them

three_chat_split.ANALYTICS: Consumers use same qualified format automatically, no percoin strategy configuration; finish BA queue review

DOOD_role: Concrete control case and active user example, not separate manual onboarding strategy
